home.title: A Next.js foundation with the gate already wired
home.description: Next.js App Router, next-intl, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Vitest and Playwright — plus the hooks, CI and agent flow that keep a fork honest from the first commit.
home.seed: This page is the template seed: replace it with the first real screen and keep the sections you still need.

inside.title: What's inside
inside.next: Next.js App Router with ISR, typed routes and a webpack production build
inside.intl: next-intl locale routing with per-locale metadata and alternates
inside.styling: Tailwind v4 tokens and shadcn/ui primitives
inside.state: Zustand with createSelectors for UI state
inside.boundary: Zod at every boundary: env, forms, the proxy, the API routes
inside.security: CSP with nonces, security headers and a same-origin guard in code, not in a doc
inside.vitals: Web Vitals reported to an API route, sourced from next/web-vitals
inside.testing: Vitest with Testing Library, Playwright, StrykerJS on a weekly schedule

iterate.title: Iterate
iterate.text: Per change, seconds: oxlint, tsc and the changed tests. One spec through the tracer when the change has one.

commit.title: Commit
commit.text: The pre-commit hook owns it: staged autofix, the TDD sibling gate, the repo-wide cheap checks, the docs check when docs are staged.

push.title: Push
push.text: The pre-push hook runs the gate once, phase-aware: before the first deploy it skips the heavy stages out loud; after it, the full chain.

ci.title: CI
ci.text: The same chain, phase-blind, plus what only CI can do: security scans, the dev smoke, the cross-browser run, the weekly mutation score.

agents.title: Agent flow
agents.lead: One file every tool reads. Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot all start from it; the brain files it points at hold the depth.

commands.onboard: read the brain, verify it against the code, report drift, stop
commands.feat: reuse check, scope, plan, test-first, gate, report
commands.test: tests that hunt corner cases at the seams, not the happy path
commands.review: senior review of the diff: leaks, security, bug hunt
commands.docs: bring the guide and the brain back in line with the code

agents.spec: Anything bigger than a one-sentence diff starts with a spec and a plan, copied from the templates folder, reviewed before the first edit.

reading.title: Where to read
reading.index: a situation mapped to the two or three files that answer it
reading.map: entry points, state boundaries, the route table
reading.skeletons: danger zones learned from real incidents
reading.verification: what to run per kind of change
reading.decisions: why the stack is the way it is, with dates and revisit triggers

steps.title: First steps
steps.prepare: installs the git hooks; lifecycle scripts are off by design
steps.iter: the iteration tier, run per change
steps.graduate: then replace this page with the first real route and keep the example form until a real form exists
